observation.command:
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
echo "=== project status/type rows ==="
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d project_logic -tAc "SELECT 'status='||count(*) FROM project_status;" 2>&1
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d project_logic -tAc "SELECT 'type='||count(*) FROM project_type;" 2>&1
echo "=== FCS category/document_type ==="
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d formal_completeness_check -tAc "SELECT 'category='||count(*) FROM category;" 2>&1
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d formal_completeness_check -tAc "SELECT 'document_type='||count(*) FROM document_type;" 2>&1
echo "=== gesetze-normen tables + counts ==="
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d gesetze-normen -tAc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY 1;" 2>&1
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d gesetze-normen -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM gesetz;" 2>&1
docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d gesetze-normen -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM norm;" 2>&1
